identity_reason: it is two Listbox recesses and two glass Buttons, so its look comes entirely from those parts
concept: Two Listboxes side by side with move buttons that say how many they will move, stacking on a narrow pane.

root.why: the wrapper measures its own width so the lists can stack when narrow

grid.why: the two lists and the buttons sit in three columns with an even gap

list.why: each list takes an equal share of the width and the full height of the row

moves.why: the move buttons stack between the lists, apart from both

glyph.why: each button carries an arrow that points the way it moves the items

fwd.why: the add arrow turns to point down when the lists stack

back.why: the remove arrow turns with the layout so it still points the right way
